mods.description: Player heads and death-created grave skulls for Better than Adventure!

releases.notes:
Adds optional compatibility with BTA 3D Skin Layers.

When both mods are installed, placed player skulls use voxel skin overlays. BTA 3D Skin Layers remains optional, and BTA Skulls continues to work normally without it.

## Requirements

- Better than Adventure 8.0.1
- Babric Loader
- HalpLibe 6.1.4 or newer
- Java 17

mods.name: BTA Skulls
mods.description: Player heads and death-created grave skulls for Better than Adventure!

releases.notes:
Initial release of BTA Skulls for Better than Adventure 8.0.1.

## Features

- Player deaths create graves using the player's head and skin.
- Breaking your grave returns its stored inventory.
- Player heads can be placed in eight directions or worn.
- Matching heads stack together.
- Renamed labels can apply another player's skin to a head.
- Includes Steve, skeleton, zombie, and creeper heads in the creative mode inventory.
- Mob heads support asset pack textures.
- Supports singleplayer and dedicated multiplayer servers.

## Requirements

- Better than Adventure 8.0.1
- Babric Loader
- HalpLibe 6.1.4 or newer
